name: CVC Metal Fabricating
old_description: At CVC, we are proud of our reputation as a trusted source of fabricated products. We have enjoyed this position for more than 50 years. From small businesses to large corporations, we have developed several long-lasting relationships built on superior service and dedication. Today, we are an industry leader in the fabrication of component parts, assemblies, and complete products.
about:
CVC Metal Fabricating operates from Florence, Kentucky, in the Greater Cincinnati region. The company traces its roots to the Cincinnati Ventilating Co. Inc., established more than 80 years ago, and has remained a family-owned-and-operated business across four generations.

The shop specializes in metal fabrication, producing component parts, assemblies, and complete products. Its capabilities include six-axis laser cutting, nine-axis forming, robotic welding, and multiple flexible manufacturing systems, allowing it to handle a range of project sizes.

CVC serves customers from small businesses to large corporations, primarily across the Greater Cincinnati metropolitan area but also nationwide. The company does not publicly list specific industry verticals, focusing instead on general metal fabrication needs.

The company emphasizes technology-driven manufacturing, investing in cutting-edge equipment to deliver quality and consistency at competitive prices. Its stated mission is to provide quality products in a timely manner using high-tech equipment, backed by ISO 9001:2008 certification and a commitment to superior service and dedication.
